subject: MSstatsTMT proteinSummarization error (due to duplicate features)

messages.author: b4f45db4340c181c
messages.subject: MSstatsTMT proteinSummarization error (due to duplicate features)
parts:
Hi MSstats team,

thank you for your great tools!!

I'm encountering (a warning and) an error when running the proteinSummarization function on TMT data. See attached file PD_PSMs_fails.txt. The issue can be circumvented when de-duplicating "features" (peptides sequence + charge), see attached file PD_PSMs_works.txt. 
Not sure, but this might be a bug, since I thought identical features (from e.g. fractions) should be collapsed to the "best" feature (based on mean, sum, or max abundance). 

Running:
R version 4.3.0
MSstatsTMT version 2.8.0
R code, ProteomeDiscoverer input examples, and annotation file are attached to reproduce the issue.

Best,
David

thanks for providing example data, I will see what the problem is. The behavior you described is what we implemented for fractionated data sets. I will check if annotation is correct and MSstatsTMT works as expected.

Kind regards,
Mateusz
